Bravo — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Raise the wall: Marshal a settlement's defense; the hex counts one bracket tougher for one raid (GM adjudicates). Standard fee 270 marks (Violence).

Trick — Last Stand (1/scene): When an ally within reach would drop to 0 Integrity, the Bravo intercepts, takes the damage, and makes one immediate free strike.
